name: inspira-interactive-hover-button
title: Interactive Hover Button
blurb: Button text slides up on hover.
description: A button where the text slides up and fades in on hover, revealing an underline. Uses CSS transitions for smooth animation.
use_when: You need a polished interactive button with smooth text-motion feedback.
avoid_when: On touch-only devices where hover is unreliable.
a11y: Standard button semantics. Text animation is visual feedback. No aria attributes needed.
